subject: Post-discovery: syncing next deep-dive and evidence path
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@novacorp.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: syncing next deep-dive and evidence path

Hi Emma — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap + next steps so we keep momentum:

- Summary: You'd like to validate latency at 20k monthly calls, confirm SSO and audit log access, and see a short pilot with a sample dataset.
- Next meeting: propose a technical deep dive (45–60 min) + SSO/infra primer. I have three windows (all PT):
  * Mon Nov 9, 10:00–11:00
  * Tue Nov 10, 13:00–14:00
  * Wed Nov 11, 08:30–09:30
Please tell me which works for you (or share a preferred slot and timezone).

- Security/procurement: you mentioned including Daniel from security and procurement during the technical call. If you can loop them into this thread that would help us prep the right artifacts.

Attachments (starter pack): SOC2-snapshot.pdf, network-diagram.png. I also attached a short mutual-action-plan skeleton to speed procurement.

Related link: HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/23145

If the times above don't work I can open an alternate set later this week.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

One ask from SSO: can you include the SAML/IdP endpoints and an example SSO flow doc in the prep materials? I've looped procurement here as a placeholder (procurement@novacorp.com) — they might reply separately with exact contacts.

Prep items from our side (short):
- I'll demo a 15-min latency walkthrough with a representative dataset (we'll use a small subset you provide).
- Marissa will cover procurement cadence and the mutual-action-plan (attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

Thanks all — appreciate the clear plan. From procurement side: once the pilot scope is agreed we typically need a PO + standard MSA redline cycle; timeline is usually 2–3 weeks for small pilots and 3–5 weeks for broader commitments. Chloe / Emma — can you flag which of these applies after the demo? I'll prepare a condensed MSA + SOW template to speed review.

I put a few notes in the mutual-action-plan (Drive link) on approval owners and expected deliverables. If procurement@novacorp.com wants a quick pre-demo call to align on billing terms, I can join — propose Mon Nov 9, 11:00 PT if that helps.
